response.output:
brain.sandbox.result(job) -> dict

Live run summary: completed/selected counts, task/trial IDs, per-trial state, usage and sealed CAS trace references. Grades become available after SubmitRun. Full-run scores include forced-closed trials at zero. Detailed output is in trace files. The final summary is also in CAS.
brain.sandbox.trace(job, after=0, limit=20, trial=None) -> dict

Compact ordered event index; request/response bodies remain in per-trial files/CAS. Optional trial matches trial_id or task_id within this job. Returns items, more and next_after. Use trace_event for a body. No automatic replay of interrupted jobs.
brain.sandbox.trace_event(job, seq, offset=0, limit=12000) -> dict

Read one full trace event as bounded UTF-8 JSON text from its live file or immutable CAS trace. Returns text, bytes, next_offset and more. Follow byte offsets, limit 4–16000. Includes payloads/output without flooding a trace listing.
